notes.title: New Patch Full Oculus Support
notes.content:
Today's new patch fixed some problems our players had with the oculus. Light Tracer now supports full oculus + oculus controller support. Thank you for your support!

https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31439077/587952e1da6be6a20e3f27e793d726cf8093b0a6.png

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Light Tracer Princess Side, play the original without VR!!!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are happy to announce Light Tracer has just been updated with a mayor game-changer: Light Tracer Princess Side flatscreen mode!

When starting up the game you can now pick whether you want to play the original VR version or start up the game in the  Princess Side full Flatscreen mode , where you can enjoy the classic adventure in a whole new way.

Hope you enjoy and leave some comments in the community HUB for feedback or suggestions!

 

The Team

notes.title: Light Tracer – “A-maze-ing” Puzzle VR Experience
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31439077/4bff671b74cbace60b6a66da21e2034f6012595f.png 

Light Tracer finally arrived on Steam! The cute and beloved VR puzzle platformer from the PlayStationVR will be launched on January 15, 2018. The Steam version features further visual enhancements as well as more accurate controls to optimize the VR gaming experience. Rated with five-stars on PlayStation 4, the game also received the award for the Best Kids and Family Game during the annual Indie Prize Awards at Casual Connect USA.

Here is what they say about Light Tracer:

“Blinded by the Light” - Playstationlifestyle
Read more http://www.playstationlifestyle.net/2017/09/28/light-tracer-psvr-review-blinded-by-the-light/

“Light Tracer is a well-crafted puzzle-platform title” – Vrfocus
Read more  https://www.vrfocus.com/2017/10/review-light-tracer

“Zen Puzzler Hybrid Experience” – Honeysanime
Read more https://honeysanime.com/light-tracer-psvr-review/
 
If you own an HTC Vive, this game will enrich your VR game library and let you experience some of the magical adventures of the little princess yourself. ːsteamhappyː
